description: This file contains utility classes and functions for testing hash table behaviors, including hash policies, custom hash and equality functors, allocator wrappers, and helper functions for extracting items and keys from containers. It is part of the Abseil C++ library's internal testing utilities for hash policies.

classes.name: WithId
classes.description: A template class that assigns a unique ID to each instance, used for testing hash and equality behaviors.

classes.name: NonStandardLayout
classes.description: A struct with a string value, supporting equality and custom hash function, used for testing hash policies.

classes.name: StatefulTestingHash
classes.description: A hash functor that inherits from WithId, used for testing hash table behavior with stateful hash functions.

classes.name: StatefulTestingEqual
classes.description: An equality functor that inherits from WithId, used for testing hash table behavior with stateful equality functions.

classes.name: Alloc
classes.description: A custom allocator wrapper that tracks an ID, used for testing allocator-aware containers.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Hash operator for generic types, utilizing absl::Hash.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the ID of the allocator or object.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Extracts key-value pairs from a map container into a vector.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Extracts keys from a set container into a vector.
